title: Identifying interactions between TDP-43's N-terminal and RNA-binding domains.
authors: Scott, David D; Jena, Lipsa; Rajaram, Akash; Ang, Jason; Perez-Miller, Samantha; Kumirov, Vlad; Khanna, Rajesh; Khanna, May
journal: Protein science : a publication of the Protein Society
one_liner_zh: 该文通过NMR和蛋白-蛋白对接研究TDP-43的NTD与RRM结构域间互作及其对RNA结合的影响，属于广义蛋白-DNA/RNA互作体系，方法可迁移至TF-DNA研究，但非典型TF-DNA且无AI/物理模拟核心方法。
abstract: TAR DNA-binding Protein 43 kilodaltons (TDP-43) plays a crucial role in the pathophysiology and progression of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis, affecting familial and sporadic cases. TDP-43 is an intrinsically disordered multidomain protein that consists of an N-terminal domain (NTD(1-102)), two tandem RNA recognition motifs (RRM1(102-177) and RRM2(191-260)), and an intrinsically disordered glycine-rich C-terminal(261-414) domain. We previously identified a chemical probe that led to allosteric alterations between the RRM and NTD of TDP-43. We attributed these changes to potential interdomain interactions between the NTD and RRM segments. In this work, we compared the 2D [(1)H,(15)N] HSQC-NMR resonances of two constructs, TDP-43(102-260) (RRM domain alone) against TDP-43(1-260) (NTD linked to RRM) and observed clustered shifts in the RNA-binding sites of both RRM domains. To investigate why these shifts appeared in the RRM domains in the absence of RNA, we hypothesized that the NTD domain could be stacking on the RRM domains. Thus, we modeled NTD-RRM interactions using protein-protein docking of TDP-43 subdomains that propose NTD stacking onto the RRM domains. Using Carr-Purcell-Meiboom-Gill NMR spectroscopy, we demonstrated evidence of an interaction between NTD(1-102) and RRMs(102-260). Finally, we investigated the impact of NTD on RNA binding using 2D (15)N-HSQC-NMR and microscale thermophoresis by titration of a short UG-rich RNA sequence and observed significant changes in RNA binding between TDP-43(102-260) and TDP-43(1-260), further suggesting the NTD plays a role in TDP-43 RNA interactions.
abstract_zh: TAR DNA结合蛋白43千道尔顿（TDP-43）在肌萎缩侧索硬化的病理生理学和进展中发挥关键作用，影响家族性和散发性病例。TDP-43是一种本质上无序的多结构域蛋白，包含N端结构域（NTD(1-102)）、两个串联RNA识别基序（RRM1(102-177)和RRM2(191-260)），以及一个本质上无序的富含甘氨酸的C端（261-414）结构域。我们先前鉴定了一种化学探针，导致TDP-43的RRM和NTD之间的变构改变。我们将这些变化归因于NTD和RRM片段之间潜在的域间相互作用。在本工作中，我们比较了两种构建体TDP-43(102-260)（仅RRM结构域）与TDP-43(1-260)（NTD连接RRM）的二维[(1)H,(15)N] HSQC-NMR共振，并观察到两个RRM结构域RNA结合位点的簇集位移。为了研究为何在无RNA情况下这些位移出现在RRM结构域中，我们假设NTD结构域可能堆叠在RRM结构域上。因此，我们使用TDP-43亚结构域的蛋白-蛋白对接模拟了NTD-RRM相互作用，提出NTD堆叠在RRM结构域上。利用Carr-Purcell-Meiboom-Gill NMR波谱学，我们证明了NTD(1-102)和RRMs(102-260)之间存在相互作用的证据。最后，我们通过滴定短UG-rich RNA序列，使用二维(15)N-HSQC-NMR和微量热泳动研究了NTD对RNA结合的影响，并观察到TDP-43(102-260)和TDP-43(1-260)之间RNA结合的显著变化，进一步表明NTD在TDP-43 RNA相互作用中发挥作用。
